about: Sol today craft, RS2 part 2 (first batch 24 Nov 2026 from NASA's NSSDCA; second batch 24 Nov from each craft's own source, named in src and src_note). Figures are quoted in `as_written`. Field names follow SSE4-atomic-rockets-plan.md section 11.3 (power[], engines[], masses in tonnes, temperatures in kelvin). Launch vehicles, stages and their engines are in parts.json. A figure marked `derived` is worked out here from cited ones and says how; `secondary` means not yet from a primary source; `to_read` is a figure still wanted.

law.why: the electric output halves in 19.37 y (20 Aug 1977 to 1 Jan 1997) x ln 2 / ln(470/335) = 39.7 y: faster than plutonium-238 alone, because the thermocouples age too

power.as_written: initial output of the RTGs on Voyager was approximately 470 W ... fallen off to approximately 335 W by the beginning of 1997; each RTG ... 40.6 cm in diameter, 50.8 cm in length, and weighed 39 kg

craft.name: Apollo 11 Columbia (CSM 107)

heat_shield.material: phenolic epoxy resin in brazed stainless steel honeycomb

burns.note: NSSDCA writes 04:54:42 and 'a 2 1/2 minute firing'; the mission report's time is checked in RS3

craft.as_written: CSM mass of 28,801 kg was the launch mass including propellants and expendables, of this the Command Module (CM 107) had a mass of 5557 kg and the Service Module (SM 107) 23,244 kg

craft.name: Apollo 11 Eagle (LM-5)

landed.frame: DE 421 mean Earth/polar axis, from LRO images

craft.fate: ascent stage: not known, assumed to have hit the Moon within 1 to 4 months
craft.as_written: total mass of the LM ascent and descent stages including propellants 15103 kg; ascent stage dry 2445 kg, 2376 kg of propellant; descent stage dry 2034 kg, 8248 kg of propellant; descent engine maximum thrust of about 45,000 N; ascent engine about 15,000 N

power.as_written: two 2.3 x 8.3 meter solar arrays ... provide 10.3 kW at 1 AU (1.3 kW at end-of-life at 3 AU)

jet_power_check.why: 0.5 x 0.092 N x (3200 s x g0) / 2600 W at full power; g0 from the master data sheet

engines.as_written: maximum thrust at 2.6 kW input power of 92 mN and a specific impulse of 3200 to 1900 s
